From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Gomez <marta@novablend.com>, payments@novablend.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jul 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Remit confirmation and bank/entity mapping — urgent

Hi Marta / NovaBlend payments team,

Hope you’re well. I’m following up on invoice INV-2028-4892 (attached) for the Q3 usage run that shipped last week. We want to confirm the remittance path so collections can reconcile on your side without delays. Two quick asks: 

• Can you confirm whether NovaBlend will pay by ACH (preferred) or wire / virtual card for this invoice?
• We need to verify the receiving entity and tax mapping — do you require a W9/EIN or an EU VAT form for Redwood? Our legal entity for this invoice is Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN provided on request).

If ACH, please confirm the bank cutoff date your AP team needs (ACH run date + posting window). If wire, let us know the preferred wire reference you want on your side and we’ll provide our wire stub.

We’ve attached the invoice and the PO you referenced. Target window: if payment can be scheduled by Aug 2, that keeps the timeline intact for the integration go-live.

Attachments: INV-2028-4892.pdf (1 page, invoice), NOVABLEND_PO_4892.pdf (PO)

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation (happy to hop on a 15-min call if that’s easier).

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
From: Marta Gomez <marta@novablend.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Lee <john.lee@novablend.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jul 2028 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Remit confirmation and bank/entity mapping — urgent

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the note and the invoice. We’re aiming to clear vendor invoices this cycle but need two items from vendors before we can run ACH:

1) Vendor bank account confirmation (routing/account + bank name) or a PDF wire stub we can validate.
2) Tax documentation — for US suppliers we need a W9; for non-US suppliers we need a VAT/residency certificate to decide which entity to pay from.

We prefer ACH but we have flexibility to do a wire if the ACH timeline doesn’t fit. We saw the PO attached and will match it to the invoice, but please confirm the legal payee name (exact) and provide an EIN for our reconciliation.

John (cc) is our AP lead and will run the validation. If you can send the wire stub + the W9 by end of day Monday (Jul 29), we’ll aim for an Aug 2 payment run. Otherwise we may need to move to a wire the following business day.

Thanks — Marta
Marta Gomez
Finance Manager, NovaBlend, Inc.
marta@novablend.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Gomez <marta@novablend.com>, payments@novablend.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 27 Jul 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Remit confirmation and bank/entity mapping — urgent

Marta — thank you. Per your ask below, attached are:

• wire_instructions_redwood.txt (wire stub with bank name, routing, account, and swift)
• W9_RedwoodCorp.pdf (completed W9 for Redwood Inference, Inc.)

Payee name (exact): Redwood Inference, Inc.
EIN: 12-3456789

We can accept ACH or wire. If NovaBlend prefers virtual card for faster settlement, we can accept virtual card as well — let me know and I’ll route to our billing team to accept the card token.

To keep the go-live on schedule we’re targeting receipt of funds by Aug 2 (ACH posting) or a wire instruction scheduled for Aug 3. If you prefer the wire option to guarantee timing, please confirm and we’ll mark the invoice as pending wire.

Attachment notes: wire_instructions_redwood.txt (stub, contains bank name and routing — share only with AP); W9_RedwoodCorp.pdf (signed).

Hi Marta — Ben here (finance ops/help for collections). Quick follow:

Thanks for confirming the process. If NovaBlend needs to move to a wire to lock timing we’re happy to accept that and will flag the payment as "wire received" on our side so the integration schedule isn’t impacted. If ACH is the preference, Sergio shared our W9 and the wire stub in case you need to validate external bank details.

As a small courtesy for the go-live, if you can confirm scheduling for payment (ACH or wire) by COB Aug 1, we’ll waive the standard late reconciliation fee for this invoice and mark the account green. If there are any PO quibbles we can accept the PO number you attached (NOVABLEND_PO_4892.pdf) as-is — just confirm the matching fields.

If easier, I can be on a 10-minute call with John to validate the stub and complete the vendor verification.

Best,
Ben Carter
Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
